active_listening.definition: Listening to understand the other person's point, including checking your understanding, instead of waiting for your turn to speak.
active_listening.example: Active listening means repeating their concern back before you answer it.

bedtime.definition: The time when you get ready to sleep. It is the end of the evening.
bedtime.example: Bedtime is eight o'clock on a school night.

compute_infrastructure.definition: The chips, data centers and energy supply that make training and running large models possible.

kpar_rule.definition: A statement of what to do in a case, written for the situation the author had in mind.
kpar_rule.example: The rule says to tighten the bolt to a stated torque, and it says nothing about the old bolt.

luggage_storage.definition: Free storage of bags before check-in or after check-out, which lets you use the city without carrying a suitcase.
luggage_storage.example: Could you store my luggage until my flight in the evening?

rapport.definition: A comfortable relationship between people, built when each can predict how the other will behave.
rapport.example: We had no topic in common, but we talked for twenty minutes and had instant rapport.

spec_competence.definition: The ability to do a piece of work well.
spec_competence.example: His competence is in the numbers; the rest of the project is not his field.
